analysis.dsl.LogicalAnalysisDomain.observe
Compute a governed Metric directly at the requested output grain.
Signature: relation.observe(metric: 'MetricInputValue', *, during: 'TimeScope | TimeGrid | None' = None, at: 'datetime | GridEndpoint | None' = None, via: 'Ref[RelationshipKind] | RelationshipPath | tuple[Ref[RelationshipKind] | RelationshipPath, ...] | None' = None, by: 'tuple[MemberAxis | Ref[DimensionKind] | LogicalCategoryRelation, ...]' = (), complete_during: 'tuple[TimeScope, ...] | None' = None)
Returns: LogicalNumericRelation | LogicalRatioRelation
Input metric: Declared Metric Ref or closed runtime Metric expression to observe.
Input during: Fixed TimeScope, a TimeGrid selecting each bucket's window, or None for no added restriction.
Input at: Explicit cumulative endpoint, grid endpoint binding every time cell, or aware datetime.
Input via: Relationship Ref, RelationshipPath or nonempty tuple of paths selecting contribution roles by root identity. Omit or pass None to infer unique directed to-one paths; partial overrides leave other roots automatic.
Input by: Ordered tuple of mv.member(), categorical Dimensions, or same-Session logical member or contribution-root classifications. Independent scalar Dimension branches are allowed. The member axis retains the receiver's full primary key and Subject identity. Empty means Singleton on ordinary members, or one overall value per time bucket.
Input complete_during: Explicit business-complete scopes with aware datetime bounds. Omit for the existing observation policy; an empty tuple declares no complete buckets.
Constraint: During and at are alternatives. Ambiguous roles require via or an explicitly bound read in by. Contribution and classification paths are independent; every component must bind every axis on complete keys without fanout. Versioned fields still require an explicit attribute time. By cannot introduce a time grid; timed classifications must match the bound grid. Ordinary Metric/Count paths are directed keyed to-one between unversioned Entities. Physical admission never selects another role. Completeness requires one original sum on during=grid without grouping or at; uncovered buckets are Unknown. Business-covered observations cannot roll up; production uses DuckDB table/Parquet.
Effects: Bind a typed graph; live inputs may use schema-only R1 preflight, without business rows or Run.
Example inputs: metric, relation, buyer
Example:
import marivo.analysis as mv
result = relation.observe(metric, during=mv.time_scope(start="2026-08-01", end="2026-09-01"), via=buyer)

analysis.dsl.NumericComparison.compare
Compare one quantity under its uniquely inferred changed condition.
Signature: relation.compare(baseline: 'NumericRelation', *, align: 'ExactAlignment | OuterAlignment' = <ExactAlignment time=none; use .show()>)
Returns: LogicalComparisonResult
Input baseline: Compatible numeric endpoint from this Session and execution mode.
Input align: Checked exact correspondence, or a complete-key outer union.
Constraint: Exactly one target/time condition must differ. Decimal scales and Duration units match. Period comparison maps complete original grids to string aligned keys through an explicit time descriptor; both original times remain projections. Exact requires equal key sets; outer keep admits unequal windows, while empty_value rejects time keys outside the other observation window. Apply real-time operations to original endpoints before comparing. Both use original operands; zero baseline affects only relative. Relative is (current-baseline)/abs(baseline): -100 to -50 gives +0.5.
Effects: Construct only; no business reads.
Example inputs: baseline, current
Example:
changes = current.compare(baseline); delta = changes.absolute
